question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: Resulticks is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not a cost savings play.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beats.action: A stack of halftone paper sheets drops onto a cream chip on open ground and settles square.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Resulticks is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not a cost savings play.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI-driven customer data to Diginex's sustainability and compliance platform.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the paper stack splits and a paper screen rises from it; a cream ribbon runs from the stack to the screen, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.5B' sits beside the ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI-driven customer data to Diginex's sustainability and compliance platform.

beats.line: That turns a point solution into an integrated, end-to-end platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the paper screen folds back down into the paper stack, now one flush slab; the cream ribbon stays in place across it.
beats.delivery: That turns a point solution into an integrated, end-to-end platform.

beats.line: The move is about expanding addressable market and cross-sell opportunity.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper stack peels apart into the two paper folders, which open side by side on cyan ground.
beats.delivery: The move is about expanding addressable market and cross-sell opportunity.

beats.line: Diginex can now serve enterprises across two workflows: sustainability and compliance, and customer intelligence and marketing.
beats.headline: 2 WORKFLOWS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as a paper hand enters and taps each of the two paper folders in turn; an orange paper arrow unrolls from the folders toward the right edge and holds.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Diginex can now serve enterprises across two workflows: sustainability and compliance, and customer intelligence and marketing.

beats.line: Same customer base, broader suite, higher average contract value from one vendor.
beats.headline: HIGHER ACV
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the orange arrow, already in place, lands on a paper till drawer that slides open beside the two paper folders and stops.
beats.delivery: Same customer base, broader suite, higher average contract value from one vendor.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity. Diginex has now absorbed four distinct acquisitions across multiple geographies.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper till drawer collapses flat and its face divides into the paper folder row, four tabs standing up in a line on magenta.
beats.delivery: The risk is integration complexity. Diginex has now absorbed four distinct acquisitions across multiple geographies.

beats.line: What matters next is cross-sell traction, and revenue growing faster than the cost of integration.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL TRACTION
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the paper bar chart lies down and restacks into the paper stack on violet; a paper hand presses it flat and a cream ribbon runs from the stack to the hand.
beats.delivery: What matters next is cross-sell traction, and revenue growing faster than the cost of integration.

beats.line: Without that, the deal is financial engineering rather than a strategic unlock.
beats.headline: FINANCIAL ENGINEERING
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper hand, already tied by the cream ribbon, slips a cream paper chip under the paper stack and lifts away, leaving the stack resting on it.
beats.delivery: Without that, the deal is financial engineering rather than a strategic unlock.

raw.line: General and administrative costs rose three point four million to eight point one million, with two point two million from deal legal work.
raw.headline: $8.1M G&A
raw.action: The previous chip is covered as a black string is pinned from the paper folder row to a paper bar chart whose column climbs and holds; a coin-sized cream tag reading '$2.2M' sits beside the string, a short black line pointing at it.
raw.delivery: General and administrative costs rose three point four million to eight point one million, with two point two million from deal legal work.
